summary: ACDE #246 把 10 个 EIP 列为 Hegotá 的考虑纳入（CFI），其中包括 frame 交易的三个配套 EIP：keyed nonce（EIP-8250）、recent roots（EIP-8272）和基于状态差异操作码的交易断言（EIP-7906），还有移除退款（EIP-3298）以及重定价 EIP-8131、EIP-8279；EIP-8304 被拒；EIP-8372 和 EIP-8368 要等 Glamsterdam 主网积累 30 天数据再定。asanso 发布使用 SPHINCS 哈希签名的后量子测试网 Daisugi v0.1。

summary_en: ACDE #246 moved 10 EIPs to Considered for Inclusion (CFI) in Hegotá, including three companions to frame transactions: keyed nonces (EIP-8250), recent roots (EIP-8272) and transaction assertions via a state diff opcode (EIP-7906), plus refund removal (EIP-3298) and the repricings EIP-8131 and EIP-8279; EIP-8304 was declined, and EIP-8372 and EIP-8368 wait for 30 days of Glamsterdam mainnet data. asanso launched Daisugi v0.1, a post-quantum testnet using SPHINCS hash-based signatures.
